children: Payy has completed all eligible refunds of more than $10 and closed the claims window for its security incident. According to Odaily, the company said it will announce further updates soon. Payy was attacked through its bridge contract this September, and all balances in the contract were transferred. It subsequently opened a 30-day claims process.

title: Payy Completes Eligible Refunds and Closes Claims Window After Security Incident
